en: 3. Āyatanayamaka 3.2 Pavattivāra 3.2.1.
Uppādavāra (The Chapter on Arising)
3.2.1.1. Chapter on the Present (Paccuppannavāra) 3.2.1.1.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the eye-base arises, does the ear-base arise for that person?
For those who are being reborn with eyes but without ears, the eye-base arises,
but the ear-base does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with both eyes and ears, both the eye-base and the ear-base arise.
Or again, for whom the ear-base arises, does the eye-base arise for them?
For those who are being reborn with the ear-base but without the eye-base, the ear-base arises for them, but the eye-base does not arise for them.
For those who are being reborn with both the ear-base and the eye-base, the ear-base [arises]...
The eye base arises and the nose base arises. For whom the eye base arises, does the nose base arise for them?
For those who are being reborn possessing the eye base but lacking the nose base, the eye base arises for them, but the nose base does not arise for them.
The nose base arises. For those who are being reborn possessing both the eye base and the nose base, both the eye base and the nose base arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the nose base arises, does the eye base arise for them?
For those who are being reborn with a nose but without eyes, the nose-base arises,
but the eye-base does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with both a nose and eyes,
the nose-base arises and the eye-base also arises.
For whom the eye-base arises, for that person does the visible-object-base arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the visible-object-base arises, for that person does the eye-base arise?
For those who are to be born with a body but without eyes, the visible-object-base arises, but the eye-base does not arise for them.
The eye-base arises. For those who are being reborn with eyes, both the visible-form base and the eye-base arise.
Does the mind-base arise for one in whom the eye-base arises? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-base arises, does the eye-base arise for them?
For those who are being reborn with a mind but without eyes, the mind-base arises for them, but the eye-base does not arise for them.
For those who are being reborn with eyes, both the mind-base and the eye-base arise for them.
The eye-base arises. For whom the eye-base arises, does the mental-object-base arise for them? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the mental-object-base arises, does the eye-base arise for them?
For those being reborn who are without eyes, the base of mental phenomena arises, but the eye-base does not arise for them.
For those being reborn who possess eyes, both the base of mental phenomena and the eye-base arise. (Based on the eye-base.)
For whom the nose-base arises, for them does the visible-form base arise? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the visible-form base arises, for them does the nose-base arise?
For those who are possessed of form but are being reborn without a nose, the visible-form base arises, but the nose-base does not arise for them.
It arises. For those being reborn among those possessing a nose, both the visible-object base and the nose base arise.
For whom the nose base arises, does the mind base arise for them? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the mind base arises, does the nose base arise for them?
For those who are being reborn with a mind but without a nose, the mind-base arises,
but the nose-base does not arise for them. For those who are being reborn with a nose, both the mind-base and the nose-base arise.
Does the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) arise for one in whom the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) arises? Yes.
Or rather, does the base of the nose arise for one in whom the base of mental phenomena arises?
For those being reborn who are without a nose, the base of mental phenomena arises, but the base of the nose does not arise for them.

It arises. For those being reborn among those possessing a nose, both the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) arises and the base of the nose (*ghānāyatana*) arises. (Based on the base of the nose.
For whom the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatana*) arises, does the base of the mind (*manāyatana*) arise for them?
For those who are mindless at the moment of rebirth, the visible-form base arises, but the mind base does not arise for them.
For those who possess form and possess mind at the moment of rebirth, both the visible-form base and the mind base arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mind base arises, does the visible-form base arise for them?
For those beings being reborn in the formless realms (*arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ*), the mind-base (*manāyatana*) arises, but the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) does not arise for them.
For those beings being reborn who possess consciousness and possess form (*sacittakānaṃ sarūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ*), both the mind-base and the visible-form base arise.
Does the mental-object base (*dhammāyatana*) arise for one for whom the visible-form base arises? Yes.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) arises, does the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) arise for them?
For those beings who are reborn among the formless (arūpakā), the base of mental phenomena arises, but the base of visible forms does not arise for them.
For those beings who are reborn with form (sarūpakā), both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms arise.
[It] arises. (Based on the sense-base of visible forms.
For whom the sense-base of mind arises, for that person does the sense-base of mental phenomena arise? Yes.
Or rather, for whom the sense-base of mental phenomena arises, for that person does the sense-base of mind arise?
For those being reborn who are without consciousness, the base of mental phenomena arises, but the base of mind does not arise for them.
For those being reborn who possess consciousness, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of mind arise. (Based on the base of mind.)
3.2.1.1.2. Positive Section (Anuloma-okāsa) Where the eye-base arises, does the ear-base arise there? Yes.
Or else, where the ear-base arises, does the eye-base arise there? Yes.
Where the eye-base arises, does the nose-base arise there?
In the fine-material sphere, the eye-base arises there, but the nose-base does not arise there. In the sense-sphere, both the eye-base and the nose-base arise there.
Or else, where the nose-base arises, does the eye-base arise there? Yes.
Where the eye-base arises, does the visible-form base arise there? Yes.
Or, where the visible-form base arises, does the eye-base arise there?
In the case of non-percipient beings, the visible-form base arises there, but the eye-base does not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the visible-form base and the eye-base arise there.
Where the eye-base arises, does the mind-base arise there? Yes. Or, where the mind-base arises, does the eye-base arise there?
In the immaterial plane, the mind-base arises there, but the eye-base does not arise there. In the five-aggregate plane, both the mind-base and the eye-base arise there.
Where the eye-base arises, does the mental-object-base arise there? Yes.
Or else, where the mental-object-base arises, does the eye-base arise there?
In the case of non-percipient beings and in the formless realm, the mental-object-base arises there, but the eye-base does not arise there.
In the five-aggregate plane, both the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) arises there and the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) arises there. (Based on the eye-base.
Where the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*) arises, does the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) arise there? Yes.
Or conversely, where the visible-form base arises, does the nose-base arise there?

In the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), the base of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) arises there, but the base of smell (*ghānāyatana*) does not arise there. In the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), both the base of visible form and the base of smell arise there.

(Wherever the base of smell arises, the base of mind (*manāyatana*) and the base of mental objects (*dhammāyatana*) are exactly the same; there is no difference. However, it should be understood that from this point on, the sequence of the sections is abbreviated.
Does the base of mental objects arise wherever the base of smell arises? Yes.
Or, where the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) arises, does the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) arise there?
In the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), the base of mental phenomena arises there, but the base of the nose does not arise there.
In the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), both the base of mental phenomena and the base of the nose arise there.
(Based on the sense-base of smell.
Where the sense-base of visible form arises, does the sense-base of mind arise there?

In the case of non-percipient beings, the sense-base of visible form arises there, but the sense-base of mind does not arise there. In the five-aggregate plane, both the sense-base of visible form and the sense-base of mind arise there.
Or, where the mind-base arises, does the visible-form base arise there?
In the immaterial realm, the mind-base arises there, but the visible-form base does not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm, both the mind-base and the visible-form base arise there.
Where the visible-form base arises, does the mental-object base arise there? Yes.
Or, where the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) arises, does the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatana*) arise there?

In the formless realm (*arūpa*), the base of mental phenomena arises there, but the base of visible forms does not arise there. In the five-aggregate realm and among non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms arise. (The section based on the base of visible forms.
Where the base of mind (*manāyatana*) arises, does the base of mental phenomena arise there? Yes.
Or, where the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) arises, does the base of mind (*manāyatana*) arise there?
In the case of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the base of mental phenomena arises there, but the base of mind does not arise there.
In the fourfold and fivefold planes of existence, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of mind arise there. (The section based on the base of mind.)
3.2.1.1.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-puggalokāsa) For whom, where the eye-base arises, does the ear-base arise there?
For those who are being reborn possessing the eye-base but lacking the ear-base, the eye-base arises there, but the ear-base does not.
And for them, the ear-base arises there. For those who are being reborn with both eyes and ears, the eye-base arises and the ear-base arises there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the ear-base arises there, does the eye-base arise for that person there?
For those who are to be reborn with the ear faculty but without the eye faculty, the ear base arises there, but the eye base does not arise there for them.
For those who are to be reborn with both the ear and the eye faculties, both the ear base and the eye base arise there for them. (Abbreviated; it is the same as for "whichever" [yassa-].)
For whomsoever the mind-base arises at a certain place, does the mental-object-base arise for them at that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mental-object-base arises at a certain place, does the mind-base arise for them at that same place?
For those who are being reborn in a mindless state, the mental-object-base arises for them at that place, but the mind-base does not arise for them there.
The mind-base arises. For those who are being reborn with minds, both the mental-object-base and the mind-base arise there for them. 3.2.1.1.4.
Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala)
For whom the eye-base does not arise, for them the ear-base does not arise?
For those who are being reborn without the eye-base but with the ear-base, the eye-base does not arise, but it is not the case that the ear-base does not arise for them.
For all those passing away, and for those being reborn without the eye-base and without the ear-base...
For them, neither the eye-base nor the ear-base arises. Or conversely:
for whom the ear-base does not arise, does the eye-base not arise for them?
For those who are being reborn without ears but with eyes, the ear-base does not arise, yet it is not the case that the eye-base does not arise for them.
The eye base does not arise. For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without the ear base and without the eye base, neither the ear base nor the eye base arises.
For one in whom the eye base does not arise, does the nose base not arise?

For those who are being reborn without eye but with nose, the eye base does not arise, yet the nose base does not fail to arise for them. For all those who are passing away, and for those who are being reborn without eye and without nose,
neither the eye base nor the nose base arises.
Or again, for whom the nose-base does not arise, for them the eye-base does not arise?

For those who are being reborn without a nose but with eyes, the nose-base does not arise, but the eye-base does not fail to arise for them. [This is so] for all those passing away, and for those being reborn without a nose and without eyes.
For them, neither the nose base nor the eye base arises.
Does the visible-object base not arise for one for whom the eye base does not arise?

For those who are being reborn without the eye base but with the visible-object base, the eye base does not arise for them; yet it is not the case that the visible-object base does not arise for them.
The visible-form base does not arise. For all those who are passing away and for those who are being reborn in the formless realm, neither the eye base nor the visible-form base arises.
Or conversely, for whom the visible-form base does not arise, does the eye base not arise for them? Yes.
For whom the eye-base does not arise, for them the mind-base does not arise?
For those who are being reborn without the eye but with a mind, the eye-base does not arise, yet the mind-base does not fail to arise for them.
For all those who are passing away and for those who are being reborn without a mind, both the eye-base and [the mind-base] do not arise.
[Is it that] the mind-base does not arise and the visible-object-base also does not arise?
Or conversely, for whom the mind-base does not arise, for him does the eye-base not arise? Yes.
For whom the eye-base does not arise, for him does the mental-object-base not arise?

For those beings who are being reborn without eyes, the eye-base does not arise for them, but it is not the case that the mental-object-base does not arise for them. For all those who are passing away, neither the eye-base nor the mental-object-base arises.
Or, for whomsoever the mental-object-base does not arise, does the eye-base not arise for them? Yes. (End of the section based on the eye-base.
For whomsoever the nose-base does not arise, does the visible-form-base not arise for them?
For those who are being reborn among those without nose but with form, the nose-base does not arise,
yet the visible-form base does not fail to arise for them. For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn among those without form,
neither the nose-base nor the visible-form base arises.
Or again, for whom the visible-object base does not arise, for that person does the nose-base not arise? Yes.
For whom the nose-base does not arise, for that person does the mind-base not arise?
For those who are being reborn without a nose but with a mind, the nose-base does not arise; yet it is not the case that the mind-base does not arise for them.
The mind base does not arise. For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without consciousness, neither the nose base nor the mind base arises.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind base does not arise, does the nose base not arise for them? Yes.
For whom the nose-base does not arise, for them the mental-object-base does not arise?

For those who are being reborn without a nose, the nose-base does not arise, but it is not the case that the mental-object-base does not arise for them. For all those who are passing away, neither the nose-base nor the mental-object-base arises.
Or conversely, for whom the mental-object-base does not arise, for them the nose-base does not arise? Yes, it does. (End of the section based on the nose-base.)
For whom the visible-object base does not arise, for them the mind base does not arise?

For those beings of the formless realm who are being reborn, the visible-object base does not arise, but it is not the case that the mind base does not arise for them. For all those passing away, neither the visible-object base nor the mind base arises.
Or conversely, for whom the mind base does not arise, for them the visible-object base does not arise?

For those who are reborn in a mindless state (*acittaka*), the mind base (*manāyatana*) does not arise; yet, for them, the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) does not fail to arise. For all those who are passing away, neither the mind base nor the visible-form base arises.
Does the mental-object base (*dhammāyatana*) not arise for one for whom the visible-form base does not arise?

For those beings being reborn in the formless realms (*arūpakānaṃ upapajjantānaṃ*), the sphere of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) does not arise; yet, for them, the sphere of mental objects (*dhammāyatana*) does not fail to arise. For all those passing away (*sabbesaṃ cavantānaṃ*), neither the sphere of visible form nor the sphere of mental objects arises.

Or conversely: For whomsoever the sphere of mental objects does not arise, for that person does the sphere of visible form not arise? Yes, it does not. (End of the section based on the sphere of visible form.
For whomsoever the sphere of mind (*manāyatana*) does not arise, for that person does the sphere of mental objects not arise?

For those who are reborn in a mindless state, the mind base (*manāyatana*) does not arise, but it is not the case that the mental-object base (*dhammāyatana*) does not arise for them. For all those who are passing away, neither the mind base nor the mental-object base arises.
Or conversely, for whom the mental-object base does not arise, does the mind base not arise for them? Yes, it does. (Based on the mind base. 3.2.1.1.5.
Negative Plane (Paccanīka-okāsa)
Where the eye-base does not arise, there the ear-base does not arise? Yes.
Or else, where the ear-base does not arise, there the eye-base does not arise? Yes.
Where the eye-base does not arise, there the nose-base does not arise? Yes.
Or, where the nose-base does not arise, does the eye-base not arise there?

In the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the nose-base does not arise there, but the eye-base does not fail to arise there. In non-percipient beings and in the immaterial sphere (arūpa), neither the nose-base nor the eye-base arises.
Where the eye-base does not arise, does the visible-object-base (rūpāyatana) not arise there?

In the case of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) does not arise there, but it is not the case that the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) does not arise there. In the immaterial realm (*arūpa*), neither the eye-base nor the visible-form base arises there.
Or else, where the visible-form base does not arise, does the eye-base not arise there? Yes.
Where the eye-base does not arise, does the mind-base (*manāyatana*) not arise there?

In the formless realm (*arūpa*), the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) does not arise there, but the mind-base (*manāyatana*) does not fail to arise there. In the case of non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), neither the eye-base nor the mind-base arises there.
Or, conversely, where the mind-base does not arise, does the eye-base not arise there? Yes.
Where the eye-base does not arise, does the mental-object-base (*dhammāyatana*) not arise there? It does arise.
Or, where the sphere of mental objects (*dhammāyatana*) does not arise, does the sphere of the eye (*cakkhāyatana*) not arise there? There is none. (Based on the eye-sphere.
Where the sphere of the nose (*ghānāyatana*) does not arise, does the sphere of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) not arise there?

In the fine-material realm (*rūpāvacara*), the sphere of the nose does not arise there, but the sphere of visible form does not fail to arise there. In the immaterial realm (*arūpa*), neither the sphere of the nose nor the sphere of visible form arises there.
Or rather: Where the visible-object base does not arise, does the nose-base not arise there? Yes.
Where the nose-base does not arise, does the mind-base not arise there?

In the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose-base does not arise there, but the mind-base does not fail to arise there. In the case of non-percipient beings, neither the nose-base nor the mind-base arises there.
Or, where the mind-base does not arise, does the nose-base not arise there? Yes.
Where the nose-base does not arise, does the mental-object-base not arise there? It does arise.
Or, where the mental-object-base does not arise, does the nose-base not arise there? There is no such case. (The section based on the nose-base.)
Where the visible-form base does not arise, there the mind base does not arise? It does arise.
Or else, where the mind base does not arise, there the visible-form base does not arise? It does arise.
Where the visible-form base does not arise, there the mental-object base does not arise? It does arise.
Where the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) does not arise, does the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatana*) not arise there? None. (End of section based on the base of visible forms.
Where the base of mind (*manāyatana*) does not arise, does the base of mental phenomena not arise there? It does arise.
Or else, where the base of mental phenomena does not arise, does the base of mind not arise there? None. (End of section based on the base of mind.)
3.2.1.1.6. Negative Person-Space (Paccanīka-puggalokāsa) For whom, where the eye-base does not arise, does the ear-base not arise there?
For those who are without the eye-base but possess the ear-base at the moment of rebirth, the eye-base does not arise there; [the ear-base does not arise for them]. No.

And for them, the ear-base does not arise there. For all those who are passing away, and for those being reborn who are without eye and without ear, neither the eye-base nor the ear-base arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the ear-base does not arise there, does the eye-base also not arise there for that person?
For those who are being reborn without the ear faculty but with the eye faculty, the ear base does not arise there for them, yet the eye base does not fail to arise there for them.
For all those who are passing away, and for those who are being reborn without both the ear and eye faculties, neither the ear base nor the eye base arises there for them. …pe…
For whom, wherever the mind-base does not arise, for them there the dhamma-base does not arise?
For those who are being reborn without consciousness, the mind-base does not arise there, but it is not the case that the dhamma-base does not arise for them there.
For all those who are passing away, neither the mind-base nor [the dhamma-base] arises there.
And the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) does not arise.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena does not arise at a certain place, does the base of mind (manāyatana) not arise for that person at that place? Yes.
3.2.1.2. Chapter on the Past.
3.2.1.2.1. Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the eye-base had arisen, for that person had the ear-base arisen? Yes.
Or else, for whom the ear-base had arisen, for that person had the eye-base arisen? Yes.
For whom the eye-base had arisen, for that person did the nose-base, the visible-object-base, the mind-base, or the mental-phenomena-base arise? Yes.
Or conversely, for whom the mental-phenomena-base had arisen, for that person did the eye-base arise? Yes.
For whom the nose-base, the visible-object-base, or the mind-base had arisen, for that person did the mental-phenomena-base arise? Yes.
Or, for whom the sphere of mental objects (*dhammāyatana*) had arisen, had the sphere of mind (*manāyatana*) arisen for them? Yes.
3.2.1.2.2. Positive Plane: Where the sphere of the eye had arisen … [as before] … (this section applies to the present, the past, and the future).
In the present and past, in the present and future, and in the past and future—everywhere it is the same;
one must only add the respective terms "arises" and "has arisen.
3.2.1.2.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-Puggalokāsa)
For whomsoever the eye-base had arisen at a certain place, had the ear-base arisen for that person at that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the ear-base had arisen at a certain place, had the eye-base arisen for that person at that same place? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base had arisen at a certain place, had the nose-base arisen for that person at that same place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere, the eye-base had arisen there, but the nose-base had not arisen for them there.
For those belonging to the sense-sphere, both the eye-base and the nose-base had arisen there.
Or else, for whomsoever the nose-base had arisen there, had the eye-base arisen for him there? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base had arisen at a certain place, for that person had the visible-form base arisen there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the visible-form base had arisen at a certain place, for that person had the eye-base arisen there?
For non-percipient beings, the visible-form base had arisen there, but the eye-base had not arisen there for them.
It had arisen. For those belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the visible-object base and the eye base had arisen there.
For whomsoever the eye base had arisen in a certain place, had the mind base also arisen for them in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind base had arisen in a certain place, had the eye base also arisen for them in that same place?

For those immaterial beings, the mind-base had arisen there, but the eye-base had not arisen for them there. For those belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the mind-base and the eye-base had arisen there.
For whomsoever the eye-base had arisen in a certain place, had the dhamma-base arisen for that person in that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the dhamma-base had arisen in a certain place, had the eye-base arisen for that person in that same place?
For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, the base of mental phenomena has arisen there, but the eye base has not arisen there for them.
For those of the five-aggregate realm, both the base of mental phenomena and the eye base have arisen there. (The section based on the eye base.)
For whomsoever the nose-base had arisen at a certain place, had the visible-object-base arisen for them at that same place? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the visible-object-base had arisen at a certain place, had the nose-base arisen for them at that same place?

For those of the fine-material sphere, the visible-object-base had arisen there, but the nose-base had not arisen for them there. For those of the sense-sphere, both the visible-object-base and the nose-base had arisen there.
For whom, wherever the nose-base had arisen, for them there the mind-base had arisen? Yes.
Or rather, for whom, wherever the mind-base had arisen, for them there the nose-base had arisen?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the mind-base had arisen there, but for them the nose-base had not arisen there.
The nose-base had arisen. For those sense-sphere beings, both the mind-base and the nose-base had arisen there.
For whomsoever the nose-base had arisen in a particular place, had the dhamma-base arisen for them there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the dhamma-base had arisen in a particular place, had the nose-base arisen for them there?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the base of mental phenomena has arisen there, but the base of the nose has not arisen there for them.
For those belonging to the sense-sphere, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of the nose have arisen there.
(End of the section based on the nose base.)
For whom, wherever the visible-base (rūpāyatana) had arisen, for them there the mind-base (manāyatana) had arisen?

For non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the visible-base had arisen there, but the mind-base had not arisen for them there. For those of the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), both the visible-base and the mind-base had arisen there.
Or, for whom, wherever the mind-base had arisen, for them there the visible-base had arisen?

For those immaterial beings, the mind-base had arisen there, but the visible-form base had not arisen for them there. For those of the five-aggregate plane, both the mind-base and the visible-form base had arisen there.
For whomsoever the visible-form base had arisen there, had the mental-object base arisen for him there? Yes.
Or rather, for whomsoever the mental-object base had arisen there, had the visible-form base arisen for him there?
For those immaterial beings, the base of mental phenomena had arisen there, but the base of visible forms had not arisen for them there.
For those of the five-aggregate plane and non-percipient beings, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms had arisen there.
(Based on the base of visible forms.)
For whomsoever the mind-base (*manāyatana*) had arisen at a certain place, for that person had the mental-object-base (*dhammāyatana*) arisen there? Yes.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mental-object-base had arisen at a certain place, for that person had the mind-base arisen there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are not to obtain the eye-base, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are not to obtain the eye-base—the nose-base [had] arisen for them at that plane.

[It] had arisen, yet the eye-base does not arise for them there. For those possessing the eye-base who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, both the nose-base and the eye-base have arisen and the eye-base arises there.
For whomsoever the eye-base arises there, has the visible-object-base arisen there for that person?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the eye-base arises there,
but the visible-object-base had not arisen for them there. For others who are being reborn with eyes,
both the eye-base arises there and the visible-object-base had arisen there.
Or, for whomsoever the visible base (rūpāyatana) had arisen at a certain place, does the eye base (cakkhāyatana) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane, for those being reborn in the sense sphere who are without eyes, and for non-percipient beings—the visible base had arisen for them there, but the eye base does not arise for them there. [However, it does arise] for those possessing eyes.
For those beings being reborn there, the visible-object base had arisen and the eye-base arises.
For whomsoever the eye-base arises there, had the mind-base arisen for them there?
For those beings being reborn in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa), the eye-base arises there, but the mind-base had not [previously] arisen for them there.
The mind-base had arisen for them. For those others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye-base and the mind-base arise there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mind-base had arisen there, does the eye-base arise for them there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere plane or in the formless plane,
the mind-base had arisen there, but the eye-base does not arise there for them. For those being reborn with eyes, both the mind-base and the eye-base have arisen there.
For whom and where the eye-base arises, for them has the mental-object-base arisen there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the eye-base arises there, but the mental-object-base has not arisen there for them.
For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye-base and [the mental-object-base arise].
And the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) has arisen.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena had arisen at a certain place, does the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) arise for them there?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the base of mental phenomena had arisen there for them.

And yet, the eye-base does not arise for them there. For those who are being reborn with eyes, both the mental-object-base and the eye-base had arisen and are arising there respectively. (Based on the eye-base.

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara) who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere or the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), the visible base had arisen for them at that place, but the nose base does not arise for them there. [However, it does arise] for those with a nose.
For those beings who are being reborn there, the base of visible form had arisen and the base of smell arises.
For whomsoever the base of smell arises there, had the base of mind arisen for them there? Yes.
Or rather, for whomsoever the base of mind had arisen there, does the base of smell arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the fine-material sphere, or the immaterial sphere—
mental base has arisen for them there, but nose base does not arise for them there. For those being reborn with a nose, mental base has arisen for them there and nose base also arises for them there.
For whom and where the nose-base arises, for that person and in that place, did the mental-object base arise? Yes.
Or rather, for whom and where the mental-object base had arisen, for that person and in that place, does the nose-base arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the mental-object base had arisen there.

And yet, the nose-base does not arise for them there. For those being reborn with a nose-base, the mental-object base had arisen and the nose-base arises there. (End of the section based on the nose-base.

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings, the base of visible form arises there,
but the base of mind has not arisen there for them. For others who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm,
both the base of visible form and the base of mind arise there.
Or alternatively: For whomsoever the mind-base (*manāyatana*) had arisen at a certain place, does the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*) and for those in the formless realm (*arūpa*), the mind-base had arisen there, but the visible-form base does not arise for them there.
For those being reborn into the five-aggregate realm, both the mind-base and...
The visible base (rūpāyatana) has arisen and the visible base is also arising.
For whom, where the visible base is arising, has the mental-object base (dhammāyatana) arisen there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the visible base is arising there, but for them the mental-object base has not [previously] arisen there.

The base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) had arisen. For those others who are being reborn with material form, both the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) arises and the base of mental phenomena had arisen there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena had arisen in a certain place, does the base of visible forms arise for them in that same place?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn in the formless realm, the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) had arisen there, but the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatana*) does not arise there for them.

For those being reborn in the realm possessing form, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms have arisen there and do arise there. (The section based on the base of visible forms.)
For whom and where the mind-base (*manāyatana*) arises, for them has the mental-object-base (*dhammāyatana*) arisen there?

For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*), the mind-base arises there, but for them the mental-object-base had not previously arisen there. For others who are being reborn with a mind, both the mind-base and...
And the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) has arisen.
Or else, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena has arisen at a certain place, does the base of mind (manāyatana) arise for them there?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without consciousness, the base of mental phenomena has arisen at that place.

And yet, the mind base does not arise for them there. For those who are being reborn with a mind, both the mental-object base and the mind base had arisen and do arise there respectively. (Based on the mind base. 3.2.1.4.4.

For whom the eye-base does not arise at a certain place, for them did the ear-base not arise at that place?

For whomsoever the eye-base does not arise at a certain place, had the nose-base not arisen for them at that same place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the eye-base does not arise there;

Or alternatively: for whomsoever the nose-base had not arisen at a certain place, does the eye-base not arise for them there?
For those beings being reborn in the fine-material sphere, the nose-base had not arisen there, but the eye-base does not fail to arise for them there.
For those passing away from the fine-material sphere, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere, [the nose-base had not arisen there and the eye-base also does not arise].
The nose base had not arisen and the eye base does not arise. For whom, where the eye base does not arise, has the visible-object base not arisen there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere without the eye base, and for non-percipient beings—for these [the eye base does not arise and the visible-object base has not arisen].
In that case, the eye-base does not arise for them there, yet the visible-object-base has not failed to arise for them there.

For those who attain final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for those in the formless realm (arūpa), the eye-base does not arise there and the visible-object-base also has not arisen there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the visible-object-base has not arisen at a certain place, does the eye-base not arise for him there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the visible-object base had not arisen there,
yet the eye-base does not fail to arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless realm,
neither the visible-object base nor the eye-base has arisen there, nor does the eye-base arise there.
For whom the eye-base does not arise at a certain place, for that person did the mind-base not arise there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without eyes, and for those non-material beings—the eye-base does not arise there for them, but it is not the case that the mind-base did not arise there for them. [In the case of] the Pure Abodes...
For those attaining final nibbāna and for non-percipient beings, the eye-base does not arise there and the mind-base has also not arisen there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind-base has not arisen there, does the eye-base not arise there for them?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the mind-base has not arisen there, but it is not the case that the eye-base does not arise there for them.
The eye-base does not arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, neither the mind-base nor the eye-base has arisen there.
For whomsoever the eye-base does not arise at a certain place, has the dhamma-base not arisen there for them?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without eye-sensitivity, the eye-base does not arise there;

yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base had not previously arisen for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, neither the eye-base nor the mental-object-base arises there, nor had the mental-object-base previously arisen for them there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) had not arisen at a certain place, does the base of the eye (cakkhāyatana) not arise for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the base of mental phenomena had not arisen there, yet the base of the eye does not fail to arise for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, both the base of mental phenomena and...
The eye-base did not arise, and the eye-base does not arise. (Based on the eye-base.
For whom, where the nose-base does not arise, has the visible-object-base not arisen there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without a nose, and for those of the fine-material sphere. For them...

In that case, the nose base does not arise, yet the visible-object base has not failed to arise for them there. For those pure-abode beings and for those in the formless realm, neither the nose base nor the visible-object base has arisen there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the visible-object base has not arisen at a certain place, does the nose base not arise for him there? Yes.
For whom, where the nose-base does not arise, for that person there, did the mind-base not arise?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere, the fine-material sphere, or the immaterial sphere— the nose-base does not arise there for them,
but it is not the case that the mind-base did not arise there for them.

For the beings of the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa) and for non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the nose-base (ghānāyatana) nor the mind-base (manāyatana) arises there, nor has the mind-base arisen there previously.
Or rather: for whomsoever the mind-base has not arisen at a certain place, does the nose-base not arise for that person at that place? Yes.
For whomsoever the nose-base does not arise at a certain place, has the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) not arisen for that person at that place?
For all those who are passing away and for those who are being reborn without a nose, the nose-base does not arise there,
yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base had not previously arisen for them there. For those of the Pure Abodes,
neither the nose-base nor the mental-object-base has arisen there.

Or rather: For whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) had not arisen at a certain place, for that person the base of the nose (*ghānāyatana*) does not arise there? Yes, it is so. (End of the section based on the base of the nose.
For whomsoever the base of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) does not arise at a certain place, for that person the base of mind (*manāyatana*) had not arisen there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*) and for those in the formless realm (*arūpa*), the base of visible form does not arise there; yet, for them, [the base of mind] had not [previously] arisen there either. No, it is not so. (End of the section based on the base of visible form.)

In that case, the mind base (manāyatana) has not arisen. For those who attain final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), neither the visible-form base (rūpāyatana) arises nor has the mind base arisen there.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the mind base has not arisen in a certain place, does the visible-form base not arise for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for those being reborn among the non-percipient beings, the mind-base had not arisen there,
yet the visible-form base does not fail to arise there for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings,
neither the mind-base nor the visible-form base has arisen there, nor does the visible-form base arise there.
For whom, where the visible-object base does not arise, for them there, the mental-object base had not arisen?

For all those passing away and for those being reborn in the formless realm, the visible-object base does not arise there, but it is not the case that the mental-object base had not arisen for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, the visible-object base does not arise there... [and so on].
The visible-object base does not arise and the mental-object base has not arisen.
Or, for whomsoever the mental-object base has not arisen at a certain place, does the visible-object base not arise for that person at that place?
For those beings who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes, the mental-object base has not arisen there, but the visible-object base does not [necessarily] fail to arise for them there.

The visible-object base does not arise. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, neither the mental-object base nor the visible-object base had arisen there previously, and the visible-object base does not arise there now. (End of the section based on the visible-object base.

yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base had not previously arisen for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the Pure Abodes, neither the mind-base nor the mental-object-base arises there, nor had they previously arisen there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) had not arisen at a certain place, does the base of mind (manāyatana) not arise for them there?
For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), the base of mental phenomena had not arisen there, yet the base of mind does not fail to arise for them there.

And the mind-base does not arise. (Based on the mind-base. 3.2.1.5.
