For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base arises there, but the visible-object-base will not arise for them there. For others who are being reborn with eyes...
In those [beings], the eye-base arises and the visible-form base will arise there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the visible-form base will arise there, does the eye-base arise for them there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without eyes, and for non-percipient beings—the eye-base does not arise for them there.
In that case, the visible-object base will arise for them there, but the eye base does not arise for them there.
For those being reborn with eyes, both the visible-object base will arise and the eye base arises there.
For whomsoever the eye base arises there, will the mind base arise for them there?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn into the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base arises there,
but the mind-base will not arise there for them. For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye-base arises there and the mind-base will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the mind-base will arise at a certain place, does the eye-base arise for them there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without eyes, and for those in the formless realm—the mind-base will arise for them there, but the eye-base does not arise for them there. [However,] for those with eyes...
For those being reborn there, the mind-base will arise and the eye-base also arises.
For whomsoever the eye-base arises there, will the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) arise for them there?
For those final-existence beings being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base arises there.
And for them, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise there.
For others who are being reborn with eyes, both the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) arises and the base of mental phenomena will arise there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will arise there, does the eye-base arise for them there?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without eye-faculty, the base of mental phenomena will arise there, but the eye-base does not arise for them there.
For those being reborn with eye-faculty, both the base of mental phenomena and the eye-base will arise there. (The section based on the eye-base.)
For whom and where the nose-base arises, for them will the visible-object-base arise there?

For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, the nose-base arises there, but the visible-object-base will not arise there for them. For others who are being reborn with a nose, [both arise].
For them, both the nose-base arises there and the visible-form base will arise there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the visible-form base will arise there, does the nose-base arise for them there?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere who are without a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere or the fine-material sphere—[for these, the nose-base does not arise].
In that case, the visible-object base will arise for them there, but the nose base does not arise for them there.
For those being reborn with a nose, the visible-object base will arise and the nose base also arises there.
For whomsoever the nose base arises there, will the mind base arise for them there?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm,
the nose-base arises there, but the mind-base will not arise there for them. For others who are being reborn with a nose, both the nose-base and the mind-base arise there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the mind-base (manāyatana) will arise at a certain place, does the nose-base (ghānāyatana) arise for them there?

For those passing away from the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara) who are not to possess a nose, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere, as well as for those of the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara),
the mind-base will arise there, but the nose-base does not arise for them there.
For those being reborn among those possessing a nose, the mind-base will arise there and the nose-base arises there.
For whomsoever the nose-base arises there, will the mental-object-base arise there for them?
For those final-existence beings being reborn in the sense-sphere, the nose-base arises there.
And for them, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise there.
For others who are being reborn with a nose, the nose-base arises there and the base of mental phenomena will also arise there.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will arise there, does the nose-base arise there for them?

For all those passing away who are without nose-faculty, and for those being reborn [in a realm] without nose-faculty, the base of mental phenomena will arise there, but the nose-base does not arise there for them.
For those being reborn with nose-faculty, both the base of mental phenomena and the nose-base will arise there. (The section based on the nose-base.)
For whom and where the visible base arises, for them will the mind base arise there?

For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm and for those being reborn in the non-percipient realm, the visible base arises there, but the mind base will not arise for them there. For others...
For those being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the visible-object base arises there and the mind base will also arise there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the mind base will arise there, does the visible-object base arise there for them?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm and for those in the formless realm, the mind base will arise there, but the visible-object base does not arise for them there.
In that case, the visible-form base arises. For those being reborn in the five-aggregate plane, both the mind base and the visible-form base will arise there.
For whomsoever the visible-form base arises in a particular place, will the mental-object base also arise for them in that same place?
For those destined for their final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the visible-object base arises there,
but the mental-object base will not arise there for them. For others who are being reborn with a physical body,
both the visible-object base and the mental-object base arise there, and the mental-object base will also arise there.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will arise at a certain place, does the base of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) arise for them there?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn in the formless realm (*arūpakā*), the base of mental phenomena will arise there, but the base of visible form does not arise for them there.
For those being reborn in the realms possessing form (*sarūpakā*), [the base of visible form arises].
The base of mental phenomena will arise and the base of visible forms is arising. (Based on the base of visible forms.
For whom, where the mind-base arises, will the base of mental phenomena arise there for them?
For those entering the final existence at rebirth, the mind-base arises there, but for them... [the base of mental phenomena will not arise].
In that case, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will arise.
For those others who are being reborn with a mind, both the base of mind (manāyatana) arises and the base of mental phenomena will arise there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will arise in a certain place, does the base of mind arise for them in that same place?
For all those passing away and for those mindless beings being reborn, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will arise there, but the base of mind (manāyatana) does not arise for them there.
For those with minds being reborn, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of mind will arise there. (Based on the base of mind.)
3.2.1.5.4. Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala) For whom the eye-base does not arise, will the ear-base not arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are not to obtain the eye-base, the eye-base does not arise; [but] it is not that...
And the ear-base will not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm,
and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death— for these,
the eye-base does not arise and the ear-base will not arise.
Or alternatively: for whom ear-base will not arise, for that person does eye-base not arise?

For those beings of the final existence who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final Nibbāna at the moment of rebirth—for these, ear-base will not arise, but eye-base does not fail to arise for them.

For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn in the formless plane—
at the moment of their death— the ear-base will not arise and the eye-base does not arise.
For one in whom the eye-base does not arise, will the nose-base not arise?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without eye-sense, the eye-base does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the nose-base will not arise for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their final existence in the immaterial plane, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial planes, will attain final Nibbāna there—at the moment of their passing away, [the eye-base does not arise].
The eye-base does not arise and the nose-base will not arise.
Or, for whom the nose-base will not arise, does the eye-base not arise for them?
For those at the point of rebirth in the five-aggregate realm who are final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*), and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms...
For those who will attain final nibbāna at the moment of rebirth, the nose-base will not arise;

yet it is not the case that the eye-base does not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death— [The nose-base will not arise for them.]
The nose base will not arise and the eye base does not arise.
For whom the eye base does not arise, will the visible-object base not arise for them?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the eye base does not arise; [but the visible-object base may or may not arise].
And for them, the visible-object base will not arise. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm,
and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death— for these,
neither the eye-base arises nor will the visible-object base arise.
Or, for whom the visible-object base will not arise, does the eye base not arise for them?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of rebirth—
for these, the visible-object base will not arise, but it is not that the eye base does not arise for them.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for those who will be reborn in the formless plane and attain final Nibbāna there at the moment of death,
the visible-object base will not arise and the eye base does not arise.
For whom the eye base does not arise, will the mind base not arise for them?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without eye-sense, the eye-base does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the mind-base will not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, neither the eye-base nor the mind-base will arise.
Or, for whom the mind-base will not arise, does the eye-base not arise for them?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the mind-base will not arise, but it is not the case that the eye-base does not arise for them.
[It is not so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, nor for those final-existence beings in the formless realm.
For those persons, the mind-base will not arise and the eye-base does not arise.
For whom the eye-base does not arise, will the mental-object-base not arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without eyes, the eye-base does not arise; [but it is not that the mental-object-base will not arise for them].

And for them, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, neither the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) arises nor will the base of mental phenomena arise.
Or conversely, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not arise, does the eye-base not arise for them?
For those attaining rebirth in the five-aggregate realm as beings in their final existence, the base of mental phenomena will not arise, but the eye-base does not fail to arise for them.

For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in their final existence in the immaterial realm, neither the base of mental phenomena nor the eye-base will arise. (Based on the eye-base.)
For whom the nose-base does not arise, will the visible-object-base not arise for them?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without a nose, the nose-base does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the visible-object-base will not arise for them. [This is also true] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in the fine-material and immaterial realms.
For those in their final existence and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna at the moment of death,
the nose base does not arise and the visible-object base will not arise.
Or conversely, for whom the visible-object base will not arise, does the nose base not arise for them?

For those final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*) being reborn in the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), and for those who will attain final nibbāna (*parinibbāyissa*) after being reborn in the formless realm (*arūpa*) at the moment of rebirth,
the visible-object base (*rūpāyatana*) will not arise, but the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*) does not fail to arise for them.

[This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere, for final-existence beings in the fine-material and immaterial realms, and for those [who will attain final nibbāna] in the formless realm...
For those who will attain final nibbāna after being reborn, at the moment of their death, the sphere of visible forms (rūpāyatana) will not arise and the sphere of odors (ghānāyatana) does not arise.

For one in whom the sphere of odors does not arise, will the sphere of mental objects (dhammāyatana) not arise? [The spheres of] mind (manāyatana) ... pe ... [and so on for the other sense bases]. Will the sphere of mental objects not arise for that person?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without a nose, the nose-base does not arise;

yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not arise for them. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material and immaterial realms, neither the nose-base nor the mental-object-base will arise.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise, for them does the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) not arise?

For those final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) who are being reborn in the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), the base of mental phenomena will not arise, but for them the base of the nose does not fail to arise.
[This is also the case] for those attaining final nibbāna (parinibbāna) in the sense-sphere, the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), or the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara).
For those in their final existence, neither the base of mental phenomena will arise nor does the base of the nose arise.
(End of the section based on the base of the nose.
For whom the base of visible forms does not arise, for them will the base of mind not arise … pe … nor will the base of mental phenomena arise?
For all those passing away who are non-material beings at the moment of rebirth, the base of visible form does not arise,

yet it is not the case that the base of mental phenomena will not arise for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in their final existence in the immaterial realm,
neither the base of visible form nor the base of mental phenomena will arise.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise, for them does the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) not arise?

For those final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm, the base of mental phenomena will not arise, but for them the base of visible forms does not fail to arise. [This is not the case] for those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, nor for those final-existence beings in the formless realm.
For them, neither the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will arise, nor does the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatana*) arise. (End of the section based on the base of visible forms.
For whom the mind-base (*manāyatana*) does not arise, for them will the base of mental phenomena not arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without consciousness, the mind-base does not arise; yet [the base of mental phenomena] does not [necessarily] follow.

For them, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise. For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither the base of mind (manāyatana) arises nor will the base of mental phenomena arise.
Or conversely: for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not arise, does the base of mind not arise for them?
For those attaining rebirth as beings in their final existence, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise, yet the mind base (manāyatana) does not fail to arise for them.
For those who are attaining final Nibbāna, neither the base of mental phenomena nor the mind base will arise.
(This concludes the section based on the mind base.)
3.2.1.5.5. Negative Plane (Paccanīka-okāsa):
Where the eye-base does not arise …pe… 3.2.1.5.6.
Negative Person-Plane (Paccanīka-puggalokāsa)
For whom the eye-base does not arise at a certain place, will the ear-base not arise for them at that same place?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, the eye-base does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the ear-base will not arise for them there. [This is also true] for those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm.
For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, neither the eye-base nor the ear-base arises there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the ear-base will not arise in a certain place, does the eye-base not arise for them there?
For those final-existence beings who are being reborn into the five-aggregate realm, the ear-base will not arise there.

And yet, the eye-base does not arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither the ear-base nor the eye-base will arise there.
For whomsoever the eye-base does not arise in a certain place, will the nose-base not arise for that person in that same place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without eyes, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, the eye-base does not arise there;

yet it is not the case that the nose-base will not arise for them there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, for those passing away from the fine-material sphere, and for non-percipient beings and those in the immaterial realm, neither the eye-base nor [the nose-base] arises there.
And the nose-base will not arise.
Or, for whomsoever the nose-base will not arise at a certain place, does the eye-base not arise for them there?

For those who are final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) being reborn in the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), and for those being reborn in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara), [the eye-base does not arise] there.
The nose base will not arise, but the eye base does not fail to arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere,
for those passing away from the fine-material sphere, and for non-percipient beings and those in the immaterial sphere,
neither the nose base nor the eye base will arise there.
For whom, where the eye-base does not arise, will the visible-object-base not arise there?

For those passing away from the five-aggregate realm, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without eyes, and for non-percipient beings—for them, the eye-base does not arise there, but it is not the case that the visible-object-base will not arise there for them. In the five-aggregate realm...
For those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm, neither the eye-base nor the visible-object-base arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the visible-object-base will not arise in a certain place, does the eye-base not arise for them there?
For those attaining rebirth in the five-aggregate plane during their final existence, the visible-object-base will not arise there.

And yet, for them, the eye base does not arise there. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in the formless realm, neither the visible-object base nor the eye base will arise there.
For whomsoever the eye base does not arise in a certain place, will the mind base not arise for them in that same place?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane who are not to obtain eye-sense, and for those being reborn in the sense-sphere or in the formless realm, the eye-base does not arise there;
yet it is not the case that the mind-base will not arise there for them.
For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their last existence in the formless realm, and for non-percipient beings, the eye-base [does not arise] there.
The mind-base does not arise and will not arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-base will not arise at a certain place, does the eye-base not arise for them at that place?
For those who are to take rebirth in the five-aggregate realm as final-existence beings, the mind-base will not arise there.

And yet, for them, the eye-base does not arise there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for non-percipient beings, the mind-base will not arise there and the eye-base also does not arise.
For whomsoever the eye-base does not arise in a certain place, will the dhamma-base not arise for them in that same place?
For all those passing away who are not to obtain the eye-base at rebirth, the eye-base does not arise there for them;

yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not arise there for them. For those attaining final Nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane and for those in their last existence in the immaterial plane, neither the eye-base nor the mental-object-base will arise there.
Or again, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise at a certain place, does the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) not arise for them there?

For those final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) who are being reborn in the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), the base of mental phenomena will not arise there, but the eye-base does not fail to arise for them there.
[This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those final-existence beings in the formless realm (arūpa).
For them, neither the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will arise there, nor does the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) arise there. (Based on the eye-base.
For whom the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*) does not arise at a certain place, will the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) not arise for them at that place?
For those passing away from the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), for those being reborn in the sense-sphere who are without a nose, and for those of the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*). For these...
In that case, the nose base does not arise, yet the visible-object base will not fail to arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm,
and for those in their final existence in the fine-material realm and for those in the immaterial realm,
neither the nose base nor the visible-object base will arise there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the visible base will not arise at a certain place, does the nose base not arise for them there?

For those final-existence beings who are being reborn in the sense-sphere, the visible base will not arise there, but the nose base does not fail to arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere or the fine-material sphere...
For those beings in their final existence in the formless realm, neither the visible-object base nor the nose base will arise there.
For whom the nose base does not arise at a certain place, will the mind base not arise for them there? [It will not.
For those passing away from the sense-sphere realm who are without a nose, for those being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, and for those of the fine-material and immaterial realms.
For them, the nose base does not arise there, but it is not the case that the mind base will not arise for them there.
For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense sphere, for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial spheres, and for non-percipient beings,
neither the nose base nor the mind base will arise there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the mind-base (*manāyatana*) will not arise at a certain place, does the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*) not arise for them there?
For those final-existence beings (*pacchimabhavika*) who are being reborn in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmāvacara*), the mind-base will not arise there;
yet for them, the nose-base does not fail to arise there. [This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm and for those in the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*).
For those in the formless realm who are in their final existence and for non-percipient beings,
the mind base will not arise and the nose base does not arise there.
For whomsoever the nose base does not arise there, will the mental object base not arise for them there?
For all those who are passing away and for those being reborn without a nose, the nose-base does not arise there;

yet it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere realm, and for those in their final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms, neither the nose-base nor the mental-object-base will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise at a certain place, does the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) not arise for them there?

For those final-existence beings (pacchimabhavika) who are being reborn in the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), the base of mental phenomena will not arise there, yet the base of the nose does not fail to arise for them there.
[This is also the case] for those attaining final nibbāna in the sense-sphere and for those in the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara).
For those in the final existence in the formless realm, neither the base of mental phenomena nor the base of the nose will arise there.
(End of the section based on the base of the nose.
For whom, where the base of visible forms does not arise, will the base of mind not arise there?
For those passing away from the five-aggregate plane and for those non-percipient beings, the visible-base sphere does not arise there;

yet it is not the case that the mind-base sphere will not arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate plane, for those in their final existence in the formless plane, and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings, neither the visible-base sphere nor the mind-base sphere will arise there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the mind-base (manāyatana) will not arise at a certain place, does the visible-form base (rūpāyatana) not arise for them there?

For those who are to be reborn in the final existence (pacchimabhavika) in the five-aggregate realm and for those who are to be reborn among the non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the mind-base will not arise there;
yet for them, the visible-form base does not fail to arise there. In the five-aggregate realm...
For those attaining final nibbāna in the formless realm, for those in their final existence in the formless realm, and for those passing away from the non-percipient beings— among these,
neither the mind-base nor the visible-form base will arise there.
For whomsoever the visible-form base does not arise in a certain place, will the mental-object base not arise for them in that same place?
For all those passing away from the formless realm and for those being reborn there, the base of visible form does not arise there;

yet it is not the case that the base of mental phenomena will not arise for them there. For those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, neither the base of visible form nor the base of mental phenomena will arise there.
Or rather, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise at a certain place, for that person does the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) not arise there?

For those undergoing final existence (pacchimabhavika) who are being reborn into the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), the base of mental phenomena will not arise there, yet for them the base of visible forms does not fail to arise there. [This is so] for those attaining final nibbāna in the five-aggregate realm and for those undergoing final existence in the formless realm (arūpa).

For them, neither the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will arise there, nor does the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatana*) arise there. (End of the section based on the base of visible forms.
Does the base of mental phenomena not arise for that person at that place where the base of mind (*manāyatana*) does not arise?
For all those passing away and for those being reborn who are without consciousness, the base of mind does not arise there.

And for them, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise there. For those attaining final nibbāna, neither the base of mind (manāyatana) nor the base of mental phenomena arises there. Or conversely:
for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not arise there, does the base of mind not arise for them there?

For those undergoing final existence who are being reborn, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise there, but it is not the case that the base of mind (manāyatana) does not arise for them there.
For those attaining final Nibbāna, neither the base of mental phenomena nor the base of mind will arise there. (The section based on the base of mind.)
3.2.1.6. Chapter on the Past and Future (Atītānāgatavāra) 3.2.1.6.1.
Positive Person (Anulomapuggala) For whom the eye-base has arisen, will the ear-base arise for that person?
For those in their final existence and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna there,
the eye base has arisen, but the ear base will not arise for them. For others, both the eye base has arisen and the ear base will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the ear-base will arise, for that person did the eye-base arise? Yes.
For whomsoever the eye-base arose, for that person will the nose-base arise?
[It will not] for those in their final existence, nor for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial realms, will attain final Nibbāna there.
The eye-base had arisen for them, but the nose-base will not arise for them. For others, however, both the eye-base had arisen and the nose-base will arise.
Or rather, for whom... [as before] ...had it arisen? Yes.
For whom the eye-base has arisen, will the visible-object-base arise for them?

For those in their final existence and for those who, having been reborn in the formless realm, will attain final nibbāna there, the eye-base has arisen, but the visible-object-base will not arise for them. For others, both the eye-base and...
[For whom] the visible-object base had arisen and the visible-object base will also arise?
Or for whom... [as before] ...had it arisen? Yes.
For whom the eye-base had arisen, will the mind-base... up to ...the mental-object base arise?

For those who are in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*), the eye-base (*cakkhāyatana*) has arisen, but the mental-object-base (*dhammāyatana*) will not arise for them. For others, both the eye-base has arisen and the mental-object-base will arise.
Or, for whomsoever... [as before] ...has it arisen? Yes. (Based on the eye-base.
For whomsoever the nose-base (*ghānāyatana*) has arisen, will the visible-form-base (*rūpāyatana*) arise for them?
For those in their final existence and for those who will be reborn in the formless realm and attain parinibbāna there,
the nose base has arisen, but the visible-object base will not arise for them. For others, both the nose base has arisen and the visible-object base will arise.
Or, for whom... [as before] ...did it arise? Yes.
For whom the nose-base had arisen, will the mind-base... [as before] ...the mental-object-base arise?
For those in their final existence, the nose-base had arisen, but the mental-object-base will not arise for them. For others, both the nose-base had arisen and the mental-object-base will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) ... [as before] ... had arisen? Yes.
For whomsoever the base of visible forms (*rūpāyatana*) had arisen, will the base of mind (*manāyatana*) ... [as before] ... the base of mental phenomena arise for them?

For those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*), the base of visible forms had arisen, but the base of mental phenomena will not arise for them. For others, both the base of visible forms had arisen and the base of mental phenomena will arise.
Or, for whomsoever... [as before] ...did it arise? Yes.
For whomsoever the mind-base (*manāyatana*) had arisen, will the cognizable-base (*dhammāyatana*) arise for them?

For those in their final existence (*pacchimabhavika*), the mind-base had arisen, but the cognizable-base will not arise for them. For others, both the mind-base had arisen and the cognizable-base will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will arise, for that person did the base of mind (manāyatana) arise? Yes.
3.2.1.6.2. Positive Plane: Where the base of eye (cakkhāyatana) had arisen … pe … [and so on].
3.2.1.6.3. Positive Person-Space (Anuloma-puggalokāsa) For whom, and in what place, the eye-base has arisen, will the ear-base arise for them in that same place?
For those in the final existence in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base has arisen in that place, but the ear-base will not arise for them there.
In that case, the ear-base will arise. For those others belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the eye-base had arisen and the ear-base will arise there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the ear-base will arise there, had the eye-base arisen there for them? Yes.
For whom, where the eye-base has arisen, will the nose-base arise there?
For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere and for those in the fine-material sphere, the eye-base has arisen there, but the nose-base will not arise there for them.
For others in the sense-sphere, [the nose-base will arise there].
The eye-base has arisen and the nose-base will arise.
Or, for whom and where... [as before] ...has it arisen? Yes.
For whom and where the eye-base has arisen, will the visible-object-base arise there for him?
For those in the five-aggregate realm who are in their final existence, the eye-base has arisen there,
but the visible-object-base will not arise there for them. For others in the five-aggregate realm,
both the eye-base has arisen there and the visible-object-base will arise there.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the visible base (rūpāyatana) will arise at a certain place, had the eye base (cakkhāyatana) arisen for them there?
For non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the visible base will arise there, but the eye base had not arisen for them there.
For those of the five-aggregate realm (pañcavokāra), both the visible base will arise there and the eye base had arisen there.
For whom and in what place the eye-base has arisen, will the mind-base arise for them in that same place?

For those final-existence beings in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base has arisen there, but the mind-base will not arise for them there. For others in the five-aggregate realm, both the eye-base and...
[For some persons,] the mind-base has arisen and the mind-base will also arise.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-base will arise at a certain place, had the eye-base arisen for them at that place?

For those non-percipient beings, the mind-base will arise there, but the eye-base had not arisen for them there. For those of the five-aggregate realm, the mind-base will arise there and the eye-base had also arisen for them there.
For whom, and where, the eye-base has arisen, will the mental-object-base arise for them there?

For those final-existence beings in the five-aggregate realm, the eye-base has arisen there, but the mental-object-base will not arise for them there. For others in the five-aggregate realm, both the eye-base and...
...the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) had arisen and will also arise.
Or else, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will arise at a certain place, had the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) arisen for them there?
For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, the base of mental phenomena will arise there, but for them the eye-base had not arisen there.
The eye-base had arisen. For those belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the mental-object-base will arise and the eye-base had arisen there. (Based on the eye-base.
For whomsoever the nose-base had arisen at a certain place, will the visible-form-base arise for that person at that same place?
For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm, the nose-base had arisen there,
but the visible-object base will not arise there for them. For other sense-sphere beings, however,
both the nose-base had arisen there and the visible-object base will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the visible base (*rūpāyatana*) will arise at a certain place, had the nose base (*ghānāyatana*) arisen for them there?

For those belonging to the fine-material sphere (*rūpāvacara*), the visible base will arise there, but the nose base had not arisen for them there. For those belonging to the sense-sphere (*kāmāvacara*), both the visible base will arise there and the nose base had arisen there.
For whomsoever the nose base had arisen at a certain place, will the mind base (*manāyatana*) …pe… the mental-object base (*dhammāyatana*) arise for them there?
For those in the sense-sphere realm who are in their final existence, the nose-base has arisen there,
but the mental-object-base will not arise for them there. For others in the sense-sphere realm,
both the nose-base and the mental-object-base have arisen and will also arise there.
Or alternatively, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will arise at a certain place, has the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) arisen for them at that place?
For those of the fine-material sphere (rūpāvacara) and the immaterial sphere (arūpāvacara), the base of mental phenomena will arise there, but the base of the nose has not arisen for them there.
For those of the sense-sphere (kāmāvacara), both the base of mental phenomena will arise and [the base of the nose] has arisen there.
And the nose-base had arisen. (Based on the nose-base.
For whom, where the visible-base had arisen, will the mind-base arise there?
For those final-existence beings in the five-aggregate realm and for non-percipient beings, the visible-base had arisen there.
And yet, the mind-base will not arise for them there. For others belonging to the five-aggregate realm, both the visible-form base and the mind-base had arisen and will arise there.
Or else, for whomsoever the mind-base will arise there, had the visible-form base arisen for them there?

For those non-material beings, the mind-base will arise there, but the visible-form base has not arisen for them there. For those of the five-aggregate realm, both the mind-base will arise there and the visible-form base has arisen there.
For whomsoever the visible-form base has arisen there, will the mental-object base arise for them there?
For those in the final existence in the five-aggregate realm, the visible-form base has arisen there, but [the mental-object base will not arise for them there].

In that case, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will arise. For others—namely, those of the five-aggregate realm and non-percipient beings—both the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana) has arisen and the base of mental phenomena will arise there.
Or rather: for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will arise in a certain place, has the base of visible forms arisen for them in that same place?
For those immaterial beings, the base of mental phenomena will arise there, but the base of visible forms has not arisen there for them.

For those of the five-aggregate realm and non-percipient beings, both the base of mental phenomena and the base of visible forms will arise there, and the base of visible forms has also arisen there. (Based on the base of visible forms.)
For whom, wherever the mind-base (manāyatana) has arisen, will the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) arise there?
For those in their final existence (pacchimabhavika), the mind-base has arisen there, but the mental-object-base will not arise there for them.
For others—those of the four-aggregate and five-aggregate planes—the mind-base has arisen there [and the mental-object-base will also arise].
And the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will arise.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will arise at a certain place, had the base of mind (manāyatana) arisen for them at that place?
For non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the base of mental phenomena will arise there, but the base of mind had not arisen for them there.
...had arisen. For those of the four-aggregate and five-aggregate realms, there the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will arise and the base of mind (*manāyatana*) had arisen.
(Based on the base of mind. 3.2.1.6.4.
Negative Person (Paccanīka-puggala)
For whom the eye-base had not arisen, will the ear-base not arise for them? None.
Or rather, for whom the ear-base will not arise, had the eye-base not arisen for them? It had arisen.
For whom the eye-base had not arisen, will the nose-base … the visible-object-base … the mind-base … the mental-phenomena-base not arise for them? None.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise, for that person did the base of the eye (cakkhāyatana) not arise? It did arise.

For whom the base of the nose (ghānāyatana)… the base of visible forms (rūpāyatana)… or the base of the mind (manāyatana) did not arise, for that person will the base of mental phenomena not arise? There is none.
Or, for whom the base of mental phenomena will not arise, for that person did the base of the mind not arise? It did arise.
3.2.1.6.5. Negative Plane (Paccanīka-okāsa):
Where the eye-base has not arisen … [etc. … 3.2.1.6.6.
Negative Person-Plane (Paccanīka-puggalokāsa)
For whom the eye-base has not arisen at a certain place, will the ear-base not arise for them there? Yes.
Or else, for whom the ear-base will not arise at a certain place, has the eye-base not arisen for them there?
For those in the final existence in the five-aggregate realm, the ear-base will not arise for them there, yet the eye-base has not [necessarily] arisen for them there.

In that case, the eye-base has not arisen. For those of the Pure Abodes, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the formless realm, neither will the ear-base arise nor has the eye-base arisen there.
For whomsoever the eye-base has not arisen in a certain place, will the nose-base not arise for them in that same place? Yes.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the nose-base will not arise at a certain place, has the eye-base not arisen for them there?

For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm and for those in the fine-material sphere, the nose-base will not arise there, but it is not the case that the eye-base has not arisen for them there.
[This is also the case] for those in the pure-abode realms, for non-percipient beings, and for those in the immaterial sphere.
For them, neither the nose-base nor the eye-base will arise there.
For whom the eye-base has not arisen there, will the visible-object-base not arise there for them?
For non-percipient beings, the eye-base has not arisen there, but the visible-object-base does not [fail to] arise there for them.
It will not arise. For those of the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless realms, the eye-base had not arisen and the visible-object-base will not arise there.
Or else, for whomsoever the visible-object-base will not arise at a certain place, had the eye-base not arisen for them there?
For those in the five-aggregate realm who are in their final existence, the visible-object-base will not arise there, yet it is not the case that the eye-base had not arisen for them there.

In that case, the eye-base has not arisen. For those of the Pure Abodes and for those in the formless realm, neither the visible-object-base nor the eye-base will arise there, and the eye-base has not arisen there.
For whomsoever the eye-base has not arisen in a certain place, will the mind-base not arise for them in that same place?
For those immaterial beings, the eye-base had not arisen there, but it is not the case that the mind-base will not arise for them there.
For those pure-abode beings, for those in their final existence in the immaterial realm,
and for non-percipient beings, neither the eye-base nor the mind-base has arisen there, nor will the mind-base arise there.
Or alternatively: for whomsoever the mind-base will not arise at a certain place, has the eye-base not arisen for them there?
For those in the final existence in the five-aggregate realm, the mind-base will not arise there, yet the eye-base has not [previously] failed to arise for them there.
[This is not the case] for those in the Pure Abodes, for those in the final existence in the formless realm, or for non-percipient beings.
For them, neither the mind-base (manāyatana) will arise there, nor has the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) arisen there.
For whomsoever the eye-base has not arisen there, will the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) not arise for them there?
For non-percipient beings and for those in the formless realm, the eye-base has not arisen there; yet for them, it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not arise there.

The base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise. For those in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa) and for those in their final existence in the formless realm (arūpa), neither the eye-base (cakkhāyatana) nor the base of mental phenomena has arisen there, nor will the base of mental phenomena arise there.
Or, conversely, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not arise in a certain place, has the eye-base not arisen there for them?
For those in the final existence in the five-aggregate plane, the base of mental phenomena will not arise there, but the eye-base had not failed to arise for them there.

For those in the Pure Abodes and for those in the final existence in the immaterial plane, neither the base of mental phenomena nor the eye-base will arise there, and the eye-base had not arisen for them there. (End of the section based on the eye-base.)
For whom the nose-base has not arisen at a certain place, will the visible-object-base not arise for them there?
For those of the fine-material sphere, the nose-base has not arisen there, but it is not the case that the visible-object-base will not arise for them there.
For those final-existence beings of the fine-material sphere and for those of the immaterial sphere, neither the nose-base nor...
[It is] not that the visible-object base did not arise and will also not arise.
Or, for whomsoever and wherever the visible-object base will not arise, for that person there, did the nose-base not arise?
For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm, the visible-object base will not arise there; yet for them, [the nose-base] did not [fail to] arise.

In that case, the nose base had not arisen. For those final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere and for those in the immaterial sphere, neither will the visible-object base arise nor has the nose base arisen there.
For whomsoever the nose base had not arisen in a certain place, will the mind base not arise for them in that same place?
For those belonging to the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose base had not arisen there,
but it is not the case that the mind base will not arise for them there. For those in the final existence within the fine-material and immaterial spheres,
and for non-percipient beings, neither the nose base nor the mind base had arisen there, nor will the mind base arise there.
Or alternatively: For whom, wherever the mind-base will not arise, for them there has not arisen the nose-base there?
For those final-existence beings in the sense-sphere realm, the mind-base will not arise there, but it is not the case that the nose-base has not arisen there for them.
[This is also the case] for final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere, the immaterial sphere, and for non-percipient beings.
For those persons, neither the mind-base nor the nose-base will arise there. For whom the nose-base has not arisen there, will the dhamma-base not arise for them there?
For those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, the nose-base has not arisen there, but it is not the case that for them [the dhamma-base]...

In that case, the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise. For those final-existence beings in the fine-material sphere or the immaterial sphere, neither the base of the nose (ghānāyatana) nor the base of mental phenomena has arisen there, and the base of mental phenomena will not arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not arise in a certain place, has the base of the nose not arisen there for them?
For those in the final existence in the sense-sphere realm, the base of mental phenomena will not arise there, yet the base of the nose has not failed to arise there for them.

For those in the final existence in the fine-material or immaterial realms, neither the base of mental phenomena nor the base of the nose will arise there, and the base of the nose has not arisen there for them. (The section based on the base of the nose.)
For whom the visible-object base has not arisen at a certain place, will the mind base not arise for them there?
For non-percipient beings, the visible-object base has not arisen there, but it is not the case that the mind base will not arise for them there.
For those born in the Pure Abodes and for those in their final existence in the formless realm, neither the visible-object base nor the mind base will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the mind-base (*manāyatana*) will not arise at a certain place, has the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) not arisen for them there?
For those in the final existence in the five-aggregate realm (*pañcavokāra*) and for non-percipient beings (*asaññasatta*), the mind-base will not arise there;

yet, for them, the visible-form base had not [previously] failed to arise there. [This is also the case] for those in the Pure Abodes (*suddhāvāsa*) and for those in the final existence in the formless realm (*arūpa*).
For them, neither the mind-base (*manāyatana*) will arise there, nor has the visible-form base (*rūpāyatana*) arisen there.
For whom the visible-form base has not arisen there, will the mental-object base (*dhammāyatana*) not arise for them there?
For those non-percipient beings (*arūpa*), the visible-form base has not arisen there, but it is not the case that the mental-object base has not arisen for them there.

It will not arise. For those in the Pure Abodes (Suddhāvāsa) and for those in their final existence in the formless realm (arūpa), neither the base of visible forms nor the base of mental phenomena has arisen there, nor will it arise.
Or, conversely: for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena will not arise in a certain place, has the base of visible forms not arisen for them there?

For those in their final existence in the five-aggregate realm, the base of mental phenomena (*dhammāyatana*) will not arise there, but the base of visible form (*rūpāyatana*) had not failed to arise for them there.

For those in the Pure Abodes and for those in their final existence in the immaterial realm, neither the base of mental phenomena nor the base of visible form will arise there, and neither had arisen for them there. (End of the section based on the base of visible form.)
For whom, where the mind-base (manāyatana) has not arisen, will the mental-object-base (dhammāyatana) not arise there?
For non-percipient beings (asaññasatta), the mind-base has not arisen there, but it is not the case that the mental-object-base will not arise for them there.
For those of the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), neither the mind-base nor the mental-object-base will arise there.
Or, for whomsoever the base of mental phenomena (dhammāyatana) will not arise at a certain place, for that person has the base of mind (manāyatana) not arisen there?
For those in their final existence (pacchimabhavika), the base of mental phenomena will not arise there, but it is not the case that the base of mind has not arisen there for them.
For those in the Pure Abodes (suddhāvāsa), neither the base of mental phenomena nor the base of mind has arisen there.
